archetypes.name: Cyber / SOC Analyst
archetypes.primaryMission: Triage and investigate security alerts to contain credible threats with defensible evidence.

archetypes.name: Fraud Investigator
archetypes.primaryMission: Determine whether suspicious activity is fraud and produce a defensible investigation record.

archetypes.name: Financial Risk Analyst
archetypes.primaryMission: Evaluate portfolio/operational risk under scenarios and recommend governed decisions.
AIassistance: Show three scenarios with largest downside

archetypes.name: Intelligence / OSINT Analyst
archetypes.primaryMission: Map entity networks and produce evidence-backed intelligence assessments.
topQuestions: What can we claim vs hypothesize?
AIassistance: Summarize network with FACT vs HYPOTHESIS labels

archetypes.name: Enterprise Executive
archetypes.primaryMission: Understand operational state, major risks, and decisions requiring attention — without engineering internals.
AIassistance: Brief me on top three risks with evidence links

archetypes.name: Auditor / Compliance Officer
archetypes.primaryMission: Verify that decisions followed policy with complete evidence and lineage.
AIassistance: Show every decision that bypassed normal approval

archetypes.name: Engineering Operator
archetypes.primaryMission: Keep SCI OS healthy: diagnose incidents, recover safely, prove readiness without fake READY.
